items.description: POSTAL 4: No Regerts is a satirical and outrageous comedic open world first person shooter and the long-awaited true sequel to what's been fondly dubbed as "The Worst Game Ever", POSTAL 2!
items.title: POSTAL 4: No Regerts

items.description: Live a week in the life of "The Postal Dude"; a hapless everyman just trying to check off some chores. Buying milk, returning an overdue library book, getting Gary Coleman's autograph, what could possibly go wrong? Includes the Paradise Lost expansion: join the Dude as he ventures back into his former hometown, embarking on a quest to find his lost dog.
items.title: POSTAL 2 + POSTAL 2: Paradise Lost

items.description: POSTAL Redux is a high definition remake of the classic dark and surreal twin-stick isometric shooter. Take control of The Postal Dude as he fights to survive in a world gone mad with violence.
items.title: POSTAL Redux

items.description: POSTAL: Brain Damaged is a new, action-oriented take on the Running With Scissors' cult game series with throwback graphics, and fast-paced, modern gameplay. Take a wild roller coaster ride through the twisted wonderland encased in the POSTAL DUDE'S messed-up mind. POSTAL: Brain Damaged Connoisseur Edition includes Base game Official soundtrack Digital art book.
items.title: Postal: Brain Damaged - Connoisseur Edition

items.description: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies and unhinged guns. This is another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.
items.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze
